# CLI reference

`python -m roracle <command>` (the container entrypoint is `roracle`).

## `roracle`

```text
usage: roracle [-h] {api,worker,migrate,eval,rebuild,perf} ...

positional arguments:
  {api,worker,migrate,eval,rebuild,perf}
    api                 run the HTTP API
    worker              run the job worker
    migrate             alembic upgrade head
    eval                retrieval-quality evaluation
    rebuild             rebuild index-time derived fields (contextual notes)
                        per version
    perf                synthetic data and load tests (scratch DB/index only)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
```

### `roracle api`

```text
usage: roracle api [-h] [--host HOST] [--port PORT]

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --host HOST
  --port PORT
```

### `roracle eval`

```text
usage: roracle eval [-h] {run,compare,import-beir,ci} ...

positional arguments:
  {run,compare,import-beir,ci}
    run                 score a gold set per principal
    compare             A/B two configurations on one set and write a gate
                        report
    import-beir         seed a BEIR dataset (SciFact) from a local directory,
                        offline
    ci                  seed the synthetic fixture and fail on ACL violations
                        or low metrics

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
```

#### `roracle eval ci`

```text
usage: roracle eval ci [-h] --fixture FIXTURE --floors FLOORS --out OUT

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --fixture FIXTURE
  --floors FLOORS
  --out OUT
```

#### `roracle eval import-beir`

```text
usage: roracle eval import-beir [-h] --set SET_NAME --owner OWNER
                                [--dataset DATASET] [--principals A,B,C]
                                [--share-group GROUP]
                                [--visibility {private,shared,everyone}]
                                dir

positional arguments:
  dir

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --set SET_NAME
  --owner OWNER         non-admin user who owns the documents and is a gold

  --share-group GROUP
  --visibility {private,shared,everyone}
```

#### `roracle eval run`

```text
usage: roracle eval run [-h] (--set SET_NAME | --fixture PATH)
                        [--path {chat,search}] [--label LABEL]
                        [--set-override KEY=VAL] [--index INDEX] [--json OUT]
                        [--judge]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --set SET_NAME
  --fixture PATH        not implemented yet (use `eval ci`, task 2)
  --path {chat,search}
  --label LABEL
  --set-override KEY=VAL
  --index INDEX         read this ES index instead of the active one
  --json OUT
  --judge               answer and judge a sample of pairs (chat path)
```

### `roracle perf`

```text
usage: roracle perf [-h]
                    {seed-pg,seed-lsh,seed-es,load,reconcile,suite,explain}
                    ...

positional arguments:
  {seed-pg,seed-lsh,seed-es,load,reconcile,suite,explain}
    seed-pg             seed a migrated scratch database (--url must name a
                        *perf* DB)
    seed-lsh            minhash + LSH bands for the first N seeded versions of
                        a seeded DB
    seed-es             seed a perf-* Elasticsearch index
    load                open-loop load test against a running API
    reconcile           run the drift-only ACL reconcile over the scratch
                        corpus (set ROR_MUTATE_ALIAS)
    suite               every Task 10 budget against a scratch environment (CI
                        gate / report)
    explain             time a hot statement (claim) on the scratch DB

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
```

#### `roracle perf explain`

```text
usage: roracle perf explain [-h] --url URL [--iterations ITERATIONS]
                            [--warmup WARMUP] [--workers WORKERS]
                            [--budget BUDGET]
                            {claim}

positional arguments:
  {claim}

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --url URL
  --iterations ITERATIONS
  --warmup WARMUP       claims per worker discarded before measuring
  --workers WORKERS     concurrent claiming sessions (SKIP LOCKED contention)
  --budget BUDGET
```

#### `roracle perf suite`

```text
usage: roracle perf suite [-h] [--profile {ci,full}] --url URL
                          [--es-url ES_URL] [--skip-seed] [--out OUT]
                          [--budget BUDGET] [--only ONLY] [--rps RPS]
                          [--duration DURATION] [--embed-ms EMBED_MS]
                          [--rerank-ms RERANK_MS]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --profile {ci,full}
  --url URL             scratch Postgres URL (name must contain 'perf')
  --es-url ES_URL
  --skip-seed           the scratch DB and perf-chunks-1 are already seeded
  --out OUT
  --budget BUDGET
  --only ONLY           comma-separated HTTP scenarios only (skips the in-
                        process ones)
  --rps RPS             override the profile's request rate
  --duration DURATION   override the profile's measured seconds
  --embed-ms EMBED_MS
  --rerank-ms RERANK_MS
```

### `roracle rebuild`

```text
usage: roracle rebuild [-h] (--what context[,raptor] | --drop NAME)
                       [--into NAME]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --what context[,raptor]
  --drop NAME           delete a shadow index (never the active one, a re-
                        embed generation, or while jobs run)
  --into NAME           shadow index chunks-<slug>-shadow (default: active
                        index)
```
